label: Whatever has received esse has its being caused by another
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (coverage): for every x and principle z, if x's esse is received in z (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN), then some c distinct from x causes x's being (CausesIn c x esse, the tenseless CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 of DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION, mode not fixed by the type). The converse direction of the reception bridge da72ae93. After the tenseless De ente c.4 principle (what has esse not from its essence has it from another; the corpus's world-indexed version is 457698e4 over DistinctEsseAt, and no bridge between DistinctEsseAt and EsseReceivedIn is built here); the reading over EsseReceivedIn is the analyst's. Timeless and untensed: it says nothing about when the cause acts. An inertialist accepts it for begun things through the originating cause (Control part 4). For a beginningless homogeneous received-esse thing that the inertialist holds is given being at no moment, an inertialist who also accepts exercise and time symmetry must reject it for that thing: the proof of homogeneousConcurrentOfSymmetry runs thing by thing, so coverage for that thing, exercise for its cause and symmetry of its history give it a giver at every moment of its presence; Control part 1 exhibits that position. Warrant: the De ente argument is tenseless and does not distinguish begun from beginningless things, so its warrant does not come through 40a97664; but an inertialist who restricts it to begun things does so on the same change-only rationale on which it rejects 40a97664, so applying it to beginningless things is where the dispute relocates, not an independent defeat.
